## v1.2.0

In v1.2.0 the scientific documents were transfered into a new format (Quarto) and the following changes were made:

* **Animal module**:
    * Addition of herd dynamics section
    * Addition of genetics section
    * Update of ration formulation section
* **Manure module**:
    * Connections sections were removed to create a new Connections chapter
    * Corrections to MN.MET.6 and the methane yield unit and citation in the anaerobic digestion section
* **New chapters**:
    * Connections - covering the animal-manure and manure-soil and crop module connections
    * Emissions - covering home grown and purchased feed emissions
    * Highlighted updates - high level overview of changes made in each version update
